review.supported_syntax: ECMAScript 5 syntax parsed to AST; wrapper accepts only a closed data-only subset, including numeric object keys. No provider source or AST is executed.
review.token_preflight: onToken callback enforces bounded token count, balanced-delimiter depth budget, closed token vocabulary, and single unary numeric sign. No callback reentry.
review.source_review: Unmodified dist/acorn.js exposes parse and tokenizes/parses source into ESTree nodes without invoking eval or Function. The wrapper uses the official Parser.extend hook and overrides readRegexp to throw before regex validation or native RegExp compilation; both readToken_slash and parseExprAtom dispatch through this method. Comment skipping occurs separately in skipSpace through skipBlockComment and skipLineComment. The class parse method is captured once and bound to the extended class.

regex_lexical_hook.extension_api: Parser.extend(plugin) returns the plugin subclass; static Parser.parse constructs new this(options, input).parse().
regex_lexical_hook.override: readRegexp() throws SyntaxError("WebFig data forbids regular expressions") without calling the parent method.
regex_lexical_hook.qualification: Hosted tests require the exact custom regex refusal for a deeply nested regex and malformed regex character classes, and retain block/line comments and slash-containing strings. The wrapper refuses any Acorn version other than 8.19.0.

wrapper_contract.parseList: String of comma-terminated object literals; wraps in [text{}], requires ordinary-object entries and preserves the final empty object. Empty input returns [{}].
wrapper_contract.parseSchema: String containing one array expression in the closed data grammar.
wrapper_contract.parseSkin: String containing one ordinary-object expression in the closed data grammar; empty or whitespace-only input returns {}.
wrapper_contract.parse_scope: Pinned Acorn 8.19.0 Parser.extend subclass with regex lexical hook. Captured class parse method bound once to the subclass parses the entire parenthesized input plus separating newline, ECMAScript 5 script, exactly one ExpressionStatement. Nested source parentheses and suffix programs are rejected. No parseExpressionAt, revivers, source execution, or AST execution.
wrapper_contract.closed_data_grammar: Only null, strings, booleans, finite numeric literals, a single unary +/- on a numeric literal, arrays without holes, and ordinary init properties with identifier/string/finite numeric keys. Numeric keys use String(value). Own properties are defined explicitly. Duplicate keys retain their last value. __proto__, prototype, constructor are always rejected after key decoding.
wrapper_contract.materialization: Iterative work stack. Output-value and depth budgets are charged before container allocation and child scheduling; AST property/key work is charged before allocation. Output objects use Object.defineProperty for own data properties.
wrapper_contract.errors: Throws TypeError, RangeError, or Acorn SyntaxError. Callers must fail closed.
wrapper_contract.hosted_qualification: VM string and Wasm code generation disabled; all nine captured ROM schemas, actual module list, numeric-key and skin vectors, forbidden AST categories, malicious suffixes and resource budgets. Provider JavaScript is never evaluated.
wrapper_contract.local_validation: Syntax-only node --check, diff whitespace, and provenance hash inspection; hosted tests are not run locally.
